description: This is the main activity source file for an Android application, defining the MainActivity class which manages user interactions, voice input, calculator evaluation, history drawer UI, theme toggling, and connection with external utilities and custom views.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class orchestrating the calculator UI, voice input, history management, and theme toggling in the Android application.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes views, voice search, calculator keypad wiring, and history panel setup when activity is created.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the result TextView with the current expression.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the expression using CalculatorEngine, updates the result box, and stores the calculation in history.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Attaches click listeners to calculator buttons to append symbols or evaluate expressions.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Sets up button listeners for showing and hiding the history drawer.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Inflates and displays the history drawer with calculation history.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Hides and removes the history drawer from the view hierarchy.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Populates the history drawer with stored calculations and sets up clear and close buttons.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes the displayed history if the history drawer is currently visible.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for theme toggling.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles theme toggle menu item selection.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches the app theme between light and dark modes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Processes activity results, delegating speech recognition results to voiceSearchBar.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request results, delegating to voiceSearchBar.
